name: Drachentanz
description: You perform a mystical dance, pumping yourself up. For the duration, your Speed is increased by 10 feet and when you hit with a melee attack, you can deal extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line towards a target immediately before attacking it with a melee move, you have Advantage on the attack roll.

updated.details: Also increases speed and confers advantage when attacking while moving.
